brief:
An Israeli air strike in central Gaza killed one Palestinian and wounded two others, the Wafa news agency reported citing medical sources. The strike occurred in the central region of the territory.

Details of the circumstances surrounding the strike remained limited. Medical sources provided the casualty figures to the news agency, though further information about those targeted was not immediately available.
